Any AI.Zapier gives teams one place to set guardrails, manage model access, and see everything — so everyone can build with AI confidently, on any model, without waiting for permission.Start free with emailStart free with Google450K+Agents built9,000+App integrations with governed access3.39M+MCP tool calls completedSOC 2 (Type II)GDPR + CCPA compliantFor buildersGet started in secondsMCPSDKCLIClaudeConnect to ClaudePaste the following prompt into a new conversation and follow the instructions:Connect to Zapier MCP for me. If I haven't already connected to Zapier, prompt me to install the connector. After the connector is installed, use the Zapier MCP list skills tool to find the onboarding skill then run it to set me up in a flash!Open ClaudeClaude CodeConnect to Claude CodePaste the following prompt into Claude Code and follow the instructions:Install Zapier-MCP for me globally in a flash! Run this command: claude mcp add --transport http "Zapier-MCP" https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect Then give me step by step instructions for how to restart claude, then prompt with "Zapier-MCP onboard me" which will call list_zapier_skills and run the "Zapier-MCP onboarding" skill. ChatGPTConnect to ChatGPTStep 1: Turn on developer mode in ChatGPT:Turn on Developer ModeStep 2: Create your connector in ChatGPT:Create your connectorClick “Create app”Name it “Zapier MCP”Paste the URL below: https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connectLeave Authentication as-is and click “Create”Step 3: Hit “Connect” then sign in to your Zapier accountStep 4: Paste the following prompt into ChatGPT to finish setup:Use the Zapier MCP App to onboard meCursorConnect to CursorStep 1: Copy the following prompt:Set up my Zapier MCP plugin in a flash! Simply call the get_zapier_skill with name "zapier-mcp onboarding" on the plugin-zapier-zapier server and follow its instructions. If authentication is needed, help me through it, then retry.Step 2: Install the Zapier pluginInstall pluginStep 3: Paste the prompt into a new Agent chat in CursorOpenClawConnect to OpenClawPaste the following prompt into a new OpenClaw conversation and follow the instructions:Set up Zapier MCP for OpenClaw Setup steps: 1. Install mcporter if you don't have it: npx -y mcporter 2. Add the Zapier MCP server: mcporter config add zapier --url "https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect" --client-name "openclaw" 3. Verify the connection: mcporter list zapier --schema Once you've confirmed the connection works and tools are listed, call the "Zapier MCP onboarding" skill. This will walk me through adding apps and configuring my tools step by step. Follow the skill's instructions and dialogue with me until onboarding is complete.Zapier SDK is currently in BetaOption 1: Paste the following prompt into your AI editor:Install the Zapier SDK for me in a flash! Run: npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk After it installs, read the Zapier SDK onboarding docs and use them to help me get started: https://docs.zapier.com/sdk.mdOption 2: Paste the following command into your terminal:npm install @zapier/zapier-sdkSee the Zapier SDK docs for more details.Zapier SDK CLI is currently in BetaOption 1: Paste the following prompt into your AI editor:Install the Zapier SDK CLI for me in a flash! Run: npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk npm install -D @zapier/zapier-sdk-cli npx zapier-sdk login Then read the CLI docs and ask me which app I want to explore: https://docs.zapier.com/sdk/using-the-cli.mdOption 2: Paste the following command into your terminal:npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk && npm install -D @zapier/zapier-sdk-cli && npx zapier-sdk loginSee the Zapier SDK CLI docs for more details.Trusted by the world’s best companiesEvery team has AI. Now they need a system.Your teams are connecting AI tools to your business systems. Each one works great alone. The question is whether they work together — safely, visibly, without collisions.Any AI, connectedUse MCP for assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. Use Zapier SDK for custom AI apps. IT sets boundaries, not bottlenecks.Complete visibility, built inEvery AI action logged. Every model call is tracked.
